description: Pricing page restructure (design draft design/pricing-page-redesign-v3.html): one-time credit packages with 1/6/12 month terms (no subscription, no auto-renewal, one package purchase per calendar month, prorated upgrades), one-time credit packs open to everyone with a tier x term discount matrix, three-step usage explainer, terms line. Field-level update on sections.v2_main.settings.data only. The legacy subscription `plans` field is removed. h1, canonical URL, costs table (photo 24 / video 6s 24 / 10s 40 / 15s 60 / 30s 120 credits) and credits paragraphs stay unchanged; the two subscription-worded FAQ entries are rewritten for the package model.

pricingSectionHead.title: Pay Once, Create All Month
pricingSectionHead.lead: No subscription. Buy a credit package for one, six, or twelve months — one payment, credits delivered monthly. Credit packs are open to everyone, and package members unlock deeper discounts.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.who: For trying video ads and product photos.
features: All core image and video models

packs.name: Starter Pack
packs.note: A small top-up when a campaign runs long. About 4 product photos or 1 short video.

packs.name: Standard Pack
packs.note: The standard top-up for active stores. About 12 product photos or 5 short videos.

packs.name: Volume Pack
packs.note: Our lowest list price. About 40 product photos or 16 short videos.

steps.title: Pick a package
steps.text: One package purchase per calendar month. Credits land in your account at the start of every month of your term.

steps.title: Top up any time
steps.text: Credit packs are open to everyone — the bigger your package and the longer its term, the deeper your pack discount.

steps.title: Upgrade anytime
steps.text: Switch to a bigger package mid-term and pay only the difference. Unused credits carry over.

pricingTerms: Package credits are delivered monthly and expire at the end of each month of the term. Credit-pack credits are valid for 24 months from purchase.
Failed generations are automatically refunded. One package purchase per calendar month; upgrades are prorated. Prices in USD.

faqUpdates.matchQuestion: How do I move to a larger plan when I need more credits?
faqUpdates.question: How do I move to a larger package when I need more credits?
faqUpdates.answer: Switch to a bigger package from your account page. You pay only the difference for the rest of your term, and your unused credits carry over. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need help.

faqUpdates.matchQuestion: How do I cancel and keep the month I already paid?
faqUpdates.question: What happens to credits I do not use?
faqUpdates.answer: Package credits are delivered monthly and expire at the end of each month of your term. Credits from a one-time credit pack stay valid for 24 months. When a job fails, its credits return to your balance on their own.

teams: Making more than the Studio package covers, for a shop or an agency? Email support@aivideosugc.com with how many photos and videos you make in a month. We will suggest a setup that fits that volume.
ctaLead: Pick a package when you are ready.
